title: SAP Functional Analyst
description:
**SAP Functional Analyst**

**Mumbai | Hybrid | 4–7 Years Experience**

**About the Role**
: LEAD School runs SAP across Supply Chain, Finance, and Procurement. We work with an external SAP consulting and development team for functional design and build. We are looking for an internal SAP owner who sits between our business teams and the consulting partner ensuring that what gets built is actually what the business needs, and that the consulting team is held accountable to quality and timelines.

This is not a configuration or consulting role. You will not be doing SAP design yourself. You will be making sure the right work gets done, by the right people, correctly.

**What You'll Do**

* Requirement Filtering
* Work with business stakeholders to understand operational problems
* Translate them into clear, structured requirements before they go to the consulting team
* Push back on poorly defined asks; question whether SAP is even the right solution
* Reject requirements that are incomplete or ambiguous before they consume consulting bandwidth
* Consulting Team Accountability
* Review functional specifications and solution designs produced by the consulting team — and challenge them when something looks off
* Track enhancement requests through the delivery lifecycle; own the backlog and prioritization
* Ensure the consulting team's deliverables meet the requirement, not just a technical spec
* Functional Testing & UAT
* Open SAP, run transactions, look at data, and verify that what was built actually works
* Coordinate UAT with business users; document test cases and sign-off
* Identify gaps between what was delivered and what was needed before anything goes to production
* Integration & Debugging Support
* Understand LEAD's SAP integrations at a functional level (what data flows where, what triggers what)
* Help debug integration issues by tracing transactions, checking logs, and narrowing down where something broke — then handing it to the right person to fix

**What You Bring**

* 4–7 years of SAP experience — enough to navigate transactions, read a functional spec critically, and know when you're being told something that doesn't make sense
* Broad cross-module familiarity: MM, SD, FI — you don't need to be a specialist in all, but you should know how they connect
* Experience working with an external SAP consulting team, not just as a consultant yourself
* Ability to write clear requirements documents and review functional specifications
* Comfort doing hands-on functional testing in SAP — running T-codes, checking master data, validating posting logic
* Strong communication; able to hold vendors accountable without being technical muscle yourself

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a configuration role — you will not be setting up SAP yourself
* This is not a project manager role — you need real SAP knowledge, not just coordination skills
* This is not a senior architect role — you are an intelligent, accountable internal owner, not a solution designer

**Joining**
: Immediate to 30 days preferred

title: Software Development Engineer in Test III
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET III) to own the quality of our

backend platforms and microservices. You will design and build scalable test automation

frameworks in Java, validate APIs, databases and message-driven systems, and embed quality into

every stage of the product lifecycle.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You will set the test strategy for your area, mentor other SDETs,

and work closely with developers, product and DevOps teams to ship reliable, high-performance

features in a fast-moving, product-based environment.

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Quality Ownership

• Own the end-to-end quality of backend services, from requirement analysis and test

planning to release sign-off.

• Define the test strategy, coverage goals and quality metrics for microservices and APIs.

• Participate in design and architecture reviews to identify testability, risk and reliability gaps

early.

• Drive shift-left testing practices across the engineering team.

Backend & API Test Automation

• Design, build and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Java, TestNG/JUnit and

Maven/Gradle.

• Develop automated API tests for REST and SOAP services using RestAssured, Postman or

similar tools, covering functional, integration, contract and negative scenarios.

• Validate backend workflows end to end, including databases (SQL/NoSQL), caches, message

queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ) and third-party integrations.

• Use Selenium WebDriver to automate UI and end-to-end regression flows where required.

• Build reusable test utilities, test data generators and mocks/stubs for dependent services.

Performance, CI/CD & Reliability

• Plan and execute performance, load and stress tests using JMeter, Gatling or similar tools,

and analyze bottlenecks with the engineering team.

• Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) with reliable

reporting and quality gates.

• Investigate production issues, perform root cause analysis and add automated checks to

prevent recurrence.

• Monitor flaky tests, reduce execution time and keep the automation suite stable and

maintainable.

Leadership & Collaboration

• Mentor and guide SDETs and QA engineers; review test code and promote automation best

practices.

• Collaborate with developers, product managers and DevOps teams to resolve defects and

improve release quality.

• Evaluate and introduce new tools, including AI-assisted testing, to improve automation

coverage and productivity.

Candidate Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical

discipline.

• 6–9 years of experience in software testing and test automation, with significant experience

in backend and API testing.

• Strong programming skills in Java, with a good understanding of object-oriented design, data

structures and collections.

• Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and test frameworks such as TestNG or

JUnit.

• Strong experience in API testing (REST/HTTP) using RestAssured, Postman or similar tools,

including authentication, schema and contract validation.

• Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks from scratch (Page

Object Model, data-driven and BDD approaches such as Cucumber).

• Good knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, MongoDB) for data validation and

test data setup.

• Experience testing microservices and distributed systems, including message queues such as

Kafka or RabbitMQ.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD and build tools such as Maven, Gradle, Jenkins and Git.

• Working knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling.

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, the SDLC and Agile/Scrum practices.

• Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal

communication.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with observability and log analysis tools such as ELK, Grafana or Splunk

* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
* Finance Process Readiness

* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness
* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
* Functional Readiness
* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
* Data Migration Readiness

* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.

* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
* Reporting & Management Information Readiness
* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
* Controls & Compliance Readiness
* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.

* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.

As a UI/UX Designer III, you'll be the design-to-code partner for your engineering teams, helping make sure what ships matches both the visual design and the coded components of our design system. Day to day, that might mean reviewing a pull request, keeping Figma and code in step, untangling a tricky UI issue or writing the specs and agent instructions that help teams get the UI right the first time.
  
If you enjoy moving between Figma, a repo, a pull request and an AI agent in the same day, and you have a good instinct for which is the right place for each job, we'd love to hear from you.**Key Responsibilities:**

  
* Leverage AI-assisted tooling (e.g., prompt-to-layout generators, Figma-to-code plugins, and coding agent integrations) to rapidly prototype and accelerate the design-to-development pipeline
  
* Decide what belongs in Figma (exploration, intent, visual specs) and what should go straight to code through agents. Guide product teams on that split
  
* Write and maintain specs, prompts, skills and agent instructions that lead AI coding tools to produce interfaces that follow the design system
  
* Review pulls requests for UI accuracy, correct use of components and tokens, responsive behaviour and accessibility before merge
  
* Keep design and code in sync so components and tokens stay consistent from design files to production, and every change traces back to its design source
  
* Spot where generated code drifts from the design system, and feed fixes back into the components, the tokens or the agent instructions
  
* Serve as the main UI design contact for assigned product and engineering teams
  
* Partner with developers, and the agents they direct, to implement approved designs accurately
  
* Give guidance on layouts, interactions, responsive behaviour and component usage
  
* Troubleshoot UI implementation problems and recommend solutions that follow our design standards
  
* Prepare clean, well-structured Figma files and clear technical specs that developers and AI agents can act on
  
* Run UI audits to find visual inconsistencies, incorrect component usage and implementation gaps, then log defects and work with developers to resolve them
  
* Find gaps in existing components and tokens and recommend improvements
  
* Maintain UI guidelines, component usage docs and implementation standards in Confluence and in the repo, where agents can read them
  
* Document design decisions, approved patterns and reusable fixes for recurring problems
  
* Write design system release notes and tell development teams about component changes
  
* Help educate engineering teams on design system standards and the agentic workflow
  
  

**Qualifications:**

  
* 5+ years in UI design, UX engineering or front-end development in complex digital or enterprise products, including 2+ years on design systems and component-based interfaces
  
* High proficiency in Figma, including component variants, auto-layout hierarchies, and design token management
  
* Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) for UI work. Can show examples of directing an agent to build or fix UI
  
* Baseline technical literacy in modern front-end layouts to facilitate frictionless AI code handoff
  
* Working knowledge of Git and pull-request workflows (GitHub or Azure DevOps): branches, reviewing diffs, leaving actionable review comments
  
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 AA) and UI best practices
  
* Able to work with distributed teams across multiple time zones, primarily in US and India

* Ensures Accountability
  
* Manages Complexity
  
* Communicates Effectively
  
* Balances Stakeholders

* Deep expertise in mobile and tablet interaction patterns, including iOS and Android conventions
